chain.title: Prepare a machine for plates
chain.desc: Build and power a Compressor. Use the installed plate recipes to begin the materials chain for machines, oxygen equipment, and rockets.

chain.title: Press the first plates
chain.desc: Compress iron into plates for the early workshop. Check this pack for any alternative plate recipe before building a larger production line.

chain.title: A furnace for rocket materials
chain.desc: Build and supply the Etrionic Blast Furnace according to its interface and recipe viewer. It provides the steel needed by the first launch program.

chain.title: Produce steel for the launch
chain.desc: Run the installed steel recipe and keep a substantial reserve for plates, tanks, engines, and the rocket's other parts.

chain.title: Shape the rocket's shell
chain.desc: Compress steel into plates. Build the required components from the recipe viewer before assembling the final rocket at the NASA Workbench.

chain.title: Prepare the life-support components
chain.desc: Craft Oxygen Gear for the space equipment. A complete suit and an oxygen supply are separate requirements from merely owning a rocket.

chain.title: Fill oxygen before departure
chain.desc: Power an Oxygen Loader, supply its required inputs, and fill supported equipment. Check the suit's oxygen reserve before boarding the rocket.

chain.title: A chestpiece with life support
chain.desc: Craft the Space Suit chestpiece and fill its oxygen storage. It must be worn with the matching helmet, pants, and boots for the intended protection.

chain.title: Seal the helmet
chain.desc: Craft the Space Helmet and keep it with the launch equipment. Wear the complete matching suit and verify oxygen before leaving a breathable environment.

chain.title: Complete the suit's lower half
chain.desc: Craft Space Pants for the full launch suit. One armored chestpiece is not a substitute for all required space armor pieces.

chain.title: Boots for the lunar surface
chain.desc: Craft Space Boots and equip all four suit pieces. Carry repair and return supplies appropriate to the pack before the first flight.

chain.title: Prepare rocket fuel
chain.desc: Power a Fuel Refinery and supply the fluid required by the fuel recipe. Transfer the finished fuel into the rocket using the supported interaction.

chain.title: Assemble rockets from their parts
chain.desc: Build the NASA Workbench and use its rocket interface. Check the nose cone, fins, tanks, engine, and plate requirements before starting the final craft.

chain.title: A place to leave and return
chain.desc: Prepare the launch pad arrangement for the rocket and choose a clear launch site. Pack return infrastructure and fuel before leaving home.

chain.title: Build the first rocket
chain.desc: Assemble a Tier 1 Rocket and fuel it on the launch pad. Confirm a complete oxygenated suit and return supplies before launching toward the Moon.

chain.title: Make your first lunar landing
chain.desc: Reach the Moon wearing the complete suit with oxygen. Establish a safe landing area, preserve a return route, and begin looking for desh.

chain.title: The Moon's new material
chain.desc: Mine and process desh using the installed recipes. It supports the next rocket tier and stronger off-world infrastructure.

chain.title: Build a breathable outpost
chain.desc: Power and supply an Oxygen Distributor, then verify the enclosed area's oxygen behavior before removing a helmet. A machine item in your inventory does not make a room breathable.

chain.title: Prepare the Mars expedition
chain.desc: Upgrade the rocket using the Tier 2 recipe. Fuel it and bring the same complete life-support and return kit used for the first expedition.

chain.title: Land on Mars
chain.desc: Reach Mars with a charged oxygen reserve and a reliable return plan. Search for ostrum to continue the rocket materials progression.

chain.title: Refine ostrum
chain.desc: Process ostrum from the Martian expedition. Use it to prepare stronger equipment and the next rocket rather than spending the first batch on decoration.

chain.title: Upgrade protection for hotter destinations
chain.desc: Prepare the complete Netherite space-armor set, including its matching helmet, pants, and boots, and fill the oxygen supply. The chestpiece quest is only one part of the hot-planet travel kit.

chain.title: Reach the hotter planets
chain.desc: Build and fuel a Tier 3 Rocket. Prepare the full protective suit required by the intended destination before selecting it on the travel screen.

chain.title: Establish a Venus landing
chain.desc: Reach Venus with the complete protective equipment and a return route. Gather calorite while keeping the expedition's oxygen and environmental protection intact.

chain.title: The final rocket material
chain.desc: Mine and process calorite. Reserve enough for the Tier 4 Rocket and any equipment upgrades that support your next expedition.

chain.title: An optional Mercury expedition
chain.desc: Visit Mercury after checking its environmental requirements and your full suit. This exploration branch is separate from gathering Venus's calorite for the next rocket.

chain.title: Prepare for another star system
chain.desc: Assemble and fuel the Tier 4 Rocket, then stock life support and return supplies. Review the available destinations before committing to the flight.

chain.title: Reach distant Glacio
chain.desc: Travel to Glacio and establish a secure landing site. Explore its resources while preserving the equipment and fuel needed to return.

chain.title: Mobility for the established explorer
chain.desc: Craft the Jet Suit and complete its matching equipment as needed. Charge or fuel it as directed by the installed version, then test flight and life-support behavior near a safe base.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Targets cached Ad Astra 1.15.20 for Minecraft 1.20.1.
Life-support descriptions specify complete armor sets; item tasks only detect the named component.
Does not cover every celestial orbit, station, or decorative block.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
